Explain briefly why a metal spoon left in hot soup becomes warm at the handle. Aim for approximately 28–44 English tokens.

message.content: Metal is an excellent heat conductor. Its free electrons and vibrating atoms quickly transfer thermal energy from the hot soup along the spoon, warming the handle.
